chunks: From him, from al-Qasim, from Ali, from Abu Basir, similar to it.

key_terms.أَبُو بَصِيرٍ: Abu Basir, a well-known companion of the Imams.
key_terms.الْقَاسِمُ: Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, a prominent companion of Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq.
key_terms.نَحْوَهُ: Similar to it / like it, indicating a parallel ruling or narration.

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on the full dowry if the husband dies before consummating the marriage?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Isfabar confirms the continuity of the ruling that the full dowry (mahr al-mithl or agreed amount) is due upon death before consummation, reinforcing the principle that marriage contract validity persists until death or divorce. It highlights the jurisprudential consistency in Shia fiqh regarding financial obligations arising from the marital bond, even in the absence of physical intimacy.
